stated_in.quote: Enum value lookup must accept an unhashable value when it compares equal to a hashable member value, so `Directions({"sc"})` returns `Directions.DOWN_ONLY` when `DOWN_ONLY` stores `frozenset({"sc"})`.

Add the regression test artifact `tests/test_enum_lookup_regression.py` covering this lookup behavior. The file must be an executable standard-library unittest artifact that reproduces the unhashable-to-hashable lookup case.
